best: The 3V3 buck and the USB four-switch power stage read as clean left-to-right textbook paths with input caps, switches, inductor and output caps in order.
worst: Cells and Gauge is fragmented into label-only islands (protection FETs, sense resistor, fuse FET, cell wires) with dozens of autogenerated Net-(Uxxx-Pin) labels, so the pack power path and protection cannot be followed without searching nets

Support parts sit away from what they serve: MCU decoupling hangs on a shared 3V3 bus far from VDDS, the antenna pi network is split (C314 alone in the far corner, section title cut off at the page edge), USB pull-ups and caps scattered by label

Poor use of space: 3V3 sheet uses a single strip of a mostly empty page, MCU and USB sheets have large empty regions while the charger area is dense with small, occasionally overlapping text (R106/Net label, stacked pin numbers under U401)
